# events.matrix.EventMatrix { #fmrimod.events.matrix.EventMatrix }

```python
EventMatrix(name, onsets, values, durations=0, column_names=None)
```

Multi-column event representation.

This represents events with multiple simultaneous values, such as
multi-dimensional parametric modulators or pre-computed design columns.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                                    | Description                                                    | Default    |
|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| name         | [str](`str`)                                            | Name of the event                                              | _required_ |
| onsets       | [array](`array`) - [like](`like`)                       | Event onset times                                              | _required_ |
| values       | [array](`array`) - [like](`like`)                       | Matrix of values, shape (n_events, n_columns)                  | _required_ |
| durations    | [scalar](`scalar`) or [array](`array`) - [like](`like`) | Event durations. If scalar, used for all events. Default is 0. | `0`        |
| column_names | list of str                                             | Names for each column. If None, uses generic names.            | `None`     |

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name         | Type                           | Description                     |
|--------------|--------------------------------|---------------------------------|
| values       | [Array](`fmrimod.types.Array`) | Matrix of event values          |
| n_columns    | [int](`int`)                   | Number of columns in the matrix |
| column_names | list of str                    | Names of columns                |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Multi-dimensional parametric modulator
>>> event = EventMatrix(
...     name='motion',
...     onsets=[1, 2, 3, 4],
...     values=[[0.1, 0.2, 0.3],
...             [0.2, 0.1, 0.4],
...             [0.3, 0.3, 0.2],
...             [0.1, 0.4, 0.3]],
...     column_names=['x', 'y', 'z']
... )
>>> 
>>> # Pre-computed regressors
>>> event = EventMatrix(
...     name='custom',
...     onsets=np.arange(10),
...     values=np.random.randn(10, 3),
...     durations=1.0
... )
```

### apply_transform { #fmrimod.events.matrix.EventMatrix.apply_transform }

```python
apply_transform(transform)
```

Apply transformation to values.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                       | Description                                                                      | Default    |
|-----------|--------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| transform | [array](`array`) or [callable](`callable`) | If array, matrix multiply (values @ transform). If callable, apply element-wise. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                               | Description                             |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
|        | [EventMatrix](`fmrimod.events.matrix.EventMatrix`) | New EventMatrix with transformed values |

### design_matrix { #fmrimod.events.matrix.EventMatrix.design_matrix }

```python
design_matrix(sampling_points)
```

Generate design matrix columns for this event.

Creates multiple columns, one for each column in the value matrix.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type                           | Description                | Default    |
|-----------------|--------------------------------|----------------------------|------------|
| sampling_points | [Array](`fmrimod.types.Array`) | Time points to evaluate at | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                           | Description                                            |
|--------|--------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [Array](`fmrimod.types.Array`) | Design matrix columns, shape (n_timepoints, n_columns) |

### from_dataframe { #fmrimod.events.matrix.EventMatrix.from_dataframe }

```python
from_dataframe(
    df,
    name,
    onset_col='onset',
    value_cols=None,
    duration_col='duration',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Create EventMatrix from DataFrame.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                           | Description                                                                           | Default      |
|--------------|------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| df           | [pd](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`) | DataFrame containing event data                                                       | _required_   |
| name         | [str](`str`)                                   | Name for the event                                                                    | _required_   |
| onset_col    | [str](`str`)                                   | Column name for onsets                                                                | `'onset'`    |
| value_cols   | list of str                                    | Column names for values. If None, uses all numeric columns except onset and duration. | `None`       |
| duration_col | [str](`str`)                                   | Column name for durations                                                             | `'duration'` |
| **kwargs     | [object](`object`)                             | Additional arguments passed to EventMatrix                                            | `{}`         |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                               | Description              |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------|--------------------------|
|        | [EventMatrix](`fmrimod.events.matrix.EventMatrix`) | New EventMatrix instance |
